explanation: Two functional defects were identified and repaired. First, the `generate` block used non-standard Verilog syntax (`if (COND) assign ...` without `begin/end`), which would cause a syntax error in native Verilator simulation. It has been rewritten with proper SystemVerilog `generate` block syntax including `begin/end` for each conditional assignment. Second, the bad-frame detection condition incorrectly treated a partial match of masked user bits as a bad frame (any masked bit matching would trigger a drop). The condition is now corrected to require all masked bits to match the bad-frame value, ensuring accepted complete frames are preserved.
